content: Official MDN docs describe IndexedDB as asynchronous, transactional structured client-side storage with indexes, suited to offline-capable applications. localStorage persists per origin but is synchronous, string-only, and bounded; browser storage remains best-effort unless persist() is granted, and browser/device policies can evict it. Use IndexedDB behind a repository abstraction, handle quota/write errors, provide export/import backup and clear-data controls; explain that browser-local storage is not cross-device sync.
